macros.name: dcFirstOpt
macros.doc: \dcFirstOpt inserts its key-value pairs into the first optional argument of \digiCap, the one labeled ⟨pos-kvs⟩.

macros.name: digiDisplaySpace
macros.doc: A simple command to define a space to place the digital images into.

macros.name: insertCaptions
macros.doc: Places the caption at the current location to the current photo.

macros.name: insertThumbs
macros.doc: The command to insert the thumbs in a tabular environment.

macros.name: longCapFmt
macros.doc: Use this command to apply a global format to the long captions.

macros.name: noRollovers
macros.doc: You can turn off the roll over feature with \noRollovers.

macros.name: opcolorbox
macros.doc: \opcolorbox commands creates two color boxes, a larger one with a smaller one centered vertically and horizontally inside the larger one.

macros.name: setThumbAppearances
macros.doc: Set the appearances of the thumbnail images.

macros.name: shortCapFmt
macros.doc: User-interface to formatting the short captions.
